column2: Travel to the Temple of Chaos Bring the Inscribed Ultimatum to the Temple of Chaos to participate in a Trial of Chaos. Area: Chimeral Wetlands
Find a use for the Inscribed Ultimatum You've found the Temple of Chaos. Find a use for the Inscribed Ultimatum.
Take a new Inscribed Ultimatum from The Trialmaster The Trialmaster awaits your next attempt in the entrance to The Temple of Chaos. Take the Inscribed Ultimatum from him.
Place the Inscribed Ultimatum in the Temple Offering Place the Inscribed Ultimatum in the Temple Offering to undertake the Trialmaster's Challenges.
Complete the Trialmaster's Challenges Enter The Trial of Chaos and complete the Trialmaster's Challenges.
Quest Complete Quest Complete - You have completed the Trialmaster's Challenges and have earned 2 Ascendancy Points.
